description:
Goal
Remove the dead deterministic_callable_boundary_fallback and make the two silent-first-wins surface-divergence spots fail loud (or resolve soundly), so a multi-surface callable never silently picks the wrong surface in a release build.

Findings that reshaped this ticket
- The original goal ("build a first-class dispatch boundary for polymorphic indirect closures") is unnecessary. Polymorphic indirect closures already dispatch correctly through the heap closure's stored code pointer; opaque_fn_value_join (an opaque join of two reducers invoked indirectly through Enum.reduce/3) passes interp/run/build.
- deterministic_callable_boundary_fallback (native.rs, first_class_publication_boundary's Err arm) is DEAD: across the full fixture corpus + lib tests + adversarial stressors, select_inhabited_callable_boundary is only ever called with a single candidate (matched=1); the Err(()) ambiguity arm is never reached. A mutation that panics in that arm leaves the full matrix green.
- The genuine multi-surface callable condition IS reachable, but at the sibling settled_callable_boundary consumer (fz-bfh.2), and it is driven by the fz-f98 root; this fallback does not handle it.

Two silent-first-wins spots to harden (the same anti-pattern):
- deterministic_callable_boundary_fallback: delete it and its fz-x2n comment; collapse the now-unreachable Err(()) arm of first_class_publication_boundary into a loud incomplete_native_program error (matching settled_callable_boundary's existing invariant).
- native_codegen/driver.rs:971 debug_assert_eq!(previous, &next): in release this assert is compiled out and the first of two diverging closure-target surfaces silently wins. Replace with a fail-loud check or a sound surface reconciliation.

Required work
- Delete deterministic_callable_boundary_fallback; make first_class_publication_boundary's Err(()) arm a hard error.
- Harden driver.rs:971 to fail loud or reconcile soundly.
- Add a regression where the same returned/captured closure is invoked indirectly at more than one callable surface; existing direct-target coverage stays green.

Checks
- cargo test --lib; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings.
- Full fixture matrix green.

Depends on fz-f98: harden against the correct post-root-fix invariant (one coherent surface per callable value), not the currently-broken state.
title: Delete dead callable-boundary fallback; fail-loud on multi-surface surface divergence
